Product Description
The EVE 32140 15Ah 3C LiFePO4 Battery Cell is a high-performance cylindrical LFP cell designed for EV, electric mobility and high-power battery-pack applications.

With a 3.2V nominal voltage and 15Ah capacity, each cell provides approximately 48Wh of nominal energy. Its 3C discharge rating corresponds to a continuous discharge capability of up to 45A, making it suitable for applications that require higher current output and strong power delivery.

The 32140 cylindrical format offers a practical solution for building custom battery packs. LiFePO4 chemistry is widely used in electric mobility and energy-storage applications because of its stability, safety characteristics and long service potential. EVE also identifies its cylindrical cells for EV applications and highlights high consistency, low internal resistance and high-power performance across its EV cylindrical-cell range.

Important Note
3C on a 15Ah cell = 45A continuous discharge capability. Actual usable current and performance depend on the cell's specific datasheet, temperature, BMS, pack configuration and operating conditions. For a commercial listing, I would recommend using the exact EVE batch/datasheet for claims such as cycle life, internal resistance, dimensions and maximum charging current rather than assuming generic 32140 specifications. EVE's own site notes that performance can differ between individual products.
